title: ever ROSY|Short Sleeves with Bowknot High Front Slit A-Line Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Stand out as a fashionable and supportive bridesmaid with this charming Short Sleeves with Bowknot High Front Slit A-Line Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress. The delicate short sleeves feature a sweet bowknot detail, adding a youthful and feminine touch. The high front slit adds a hint of allure, making this dress perfect for a summer beach wedding or a stylish city affair. Step confidently down the aisle in this A-line chiffon dress that effortlessly blends elegance and modernity.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
